holidays.name: National Banana Split Day
holidays.description: A day to celebrate the classic sundae: a banana sliced lengthwise and topped with scoops of ice cream, syrup, whipped cream, nuts and a cherry. Grab a long dish and a few spoons.
holidays.origin: The banana split is credited to apprentice pharmacist David Strickler, who created it in 1904 at a pharmacy in Latrobe, Pennsylvania. It became a soda-fountain favorite, and the day is an unofficial observance in its honor.
holidays.funFact: Latrobe, Pennsylvania calls itself the birthplace of the banana split and hosts an annual festival in its honor.

holidays.name: Kiss and Make Up Day
holidays.description: A day for patching up quarrels, swallowing your pride and saying sorry to a friend, family member or sweetheart. A kiss is optional, but an apology is encouraged.
holidays.origin: This is an unofficial observance of unclear origin. It has become a fixture on quirky holiday calendars as a reminder to end grudges.
holidays.funFact: The day lands in late summer, which makes it a handy deadline for settling any feuds left over from the vacation season.
